summary: Tested EventCardPopup feature and Gallery APIs. All tests pass: 1) Clicking ticker events opens popup with event details, map, calendar buttons, print/download. 2) Popup shows scores for games with score data (Eagles 2 vs Hawks 0). 3) Close button (X) and backdrop click both close popup. 4) Events page (guest) shows popup when clicking events. 5) GET /api/galleries-new and /api/galleries-new/active both return 200 with valid empty arrays. 6) GalleryAdminManager uses /api/galleries-new URLs correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: EventCardPopup.js correctly renders all popup elements: type badge, title, date, teams/scores, time, location, status, description, map iframe, calendar buttons, print/download
App.js line 212-215 handleEventClick sets selectedEventForPopup state correctly
App.js lines 870-877 renders EventCardPopup when selectedEventForPopup is set
EventsTicker.js line 359 has onClick that calls onEventClick(event) to trigger popup
EventManager.js lines 366-379 onEventSelect correctly distinguishes admin (edit view) vs non-admin (popup via onEventClick)
Popup has proper data-testid attributes: event-card-popup, event-card-overlay, close-event-popup, add-google-cal, add-ical, print-event, download-event, event-map, open-in-maps
seed_data_creation: Used existing 25+ events with various types (games, tournaments, practices) and scores for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: EventCardPopup uses data-testid='event-card-popup' and data-testid='event-card-overlay'. To click ticker events use page.evaluate('document.querySelectorAll("[data-testid^=ticker-event-]")[0].click()') as Playwright force=True may not trigger React state. The galleries_new collection is empty but APIs return valid empty arrays. App uses Emergent Google OAuth for login.
